gap: The fresh strip develops straight into warm full-colour frames, identical to the wall prints, when the art bible calls for black-and-white for the flash moment, so the new strip never reads as a just-printed photobooth strip and doesn't stand apart from the rest of the wall.
notes: Countdown 3/1/smile reads well: big, pink with blue offset, inside the landing brackets. Flash peak is a full whiteout, warm at the edges and white at the centre, but it is a uniform cream field with no blown-out wall shapes, so the HDR bloom is implied rather than seen. Strip slides in from the top and the frames develop top to bottom in order. In the midpoint grabs the undeveloped frames look like flat grey cards. At v1.418 the numeral is mid-fade and looks washed-out salmon. The tape drops from above and settles between 3.0 and 3.05 with a small tilt; the press is subtle but visible. Taped frame matches the bar composition closely. No console errors.
